FAQ

1
.
Who can become a partner with Travel Next Level?
Anyone who loves to travel, share their story, and capture beautiful moments can join.
2
.
How do I get started as an affiliate?
Super simple — just reach out to us!
3
.
What commission rates can I earn, and how are they calculated?
Every partner earns a 15% commission, calculated from Travel Next Level's payouts.
4
.
Are there any upfront costs or fees to join the program?
There are zero fees to join — it's completely free!
5
.
What kind of promotional materials and resources will I have access to?
You'll have access to all Travel Next Level content, your own travel posts (with our coordination), and exclusive content created by us.
6

Earnings are super simple to receive — via PayPal, paid out monthly.
7
